templates.why_chosen: High-confidence double-column layered exemplar, rare in this template, using 3 side-by-side panels of the identical VM-hypervisor-SmartNIC-disk stack to compare where the critical path sits, with a right-side legend for three arrow styles.
templates.what_to_learn: Repeat the exact same small vertical stack across 2-3 panels and vary only which layer is bypassed or duplicated, so the comparison is about position in the stack, not shape; put a shared arrow-style legend to the right when line style, not colour, distinguishes read/write, consistency and copy traffic.

templates.why_chosen: Panels (a) and (b) repeat an identical VM/Host-Software/SmartNIC/Disk stack to contrast two data paths, then (c) duplicates that same stack across source and destination hosts linked by one dotted copy arrow, under one shared legend.
templates.what_to_learn: Reuse two copies of the same vertical stack side by side to depict a migration protocol (source host, destination host) rather than inventing new geometry, and put one legend to the right covering every line style (solid double-headed, red dashed, black dotted) used across all panels.
